quarterly_data.quarter: Caris Life Sciences press release: Caris Life Sciences Publishes npj Precision Oncology Study (08-27-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: The company published a study in npj Precision Oncology on the development and validation of Caris AI Insights for pancreatic cancer, an AI-based molecular signature that predicts first-line treatment benefit in advanced pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma, built on its clinico-genomic datasets across thousands of patients. In the testing cohort, standard molecular risk patients predicted to benefit from FOLFIRINOX achieved a median overall survival of 16.0 months when treated with FOLFIRINOX versus 9.9 months with gemcitabine plus nab-paclitaxel (gem/nab-p); approximately half of the patients in the study received a different first-line therapy than the model would have recommended, which the company says highlights the potential opportunity for more biologically informed treatment selection to improve survival and reduce toxicity. The model gives clinicians a standard / high molecular risk stratification and guidance between FOLFIRINOX and gem/nab-p.
quarterly_data.figure: median OS 16.0 vs 9.9 months; ~half of patients in the study received a different first-line therapy than the model would have recommended

quarterly_data.signal: The Caris AI Insights pancreatic signature is included in the Caris Molecular Tumor Board Report, built on WES and WTS data and available on request at no additional cost when ordering MI Cancer Seek; Caris AI Insights has disease-specific algorithms for colon, breast, ovarian, pancreatic and lung cancer. Caris received FDA approval for MI Cancer Seek in November 2024; the company calls it the first and only simultaneous WES and WTS-based assay with FDA-approved companion diagnostic (CDx) indications for molecular profiling of solid tumors.
